newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Ariza holds 56.8 pct of Berger Intl.
newsitem.headline: Ariza holds 56.8 pct of Berger Intl.

text.p: Ariza Holdings held 58.98 million shares or 56.8 percent of Berger International Ltd at the close of its takeover offer on Wednesday, said DBS Bank.
It said in a statement issued on behalf of Ariza that prior to the offer, Ariza held 53.9 million shares or 51.9 percent of Berger's issued share capital.
Ariza made an unconditional offer for Berger shares at Singapore $1.50 a share on August 17.
Ariza is an investment holding company incorporated in the British Virgin Islands and is owned by three Malaysians.
